blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle is set to preside over a Holy Mass in St. Peter’s Square at the Vatican on Wednesday following Pope Leo XIV’s hospitalization, according to the Vatican. Vatican News, citing a briefing at the Holy See Press Office, reported that Jesuit Fr. Giacomo Costa announced changes to the Mass schedule due to the pope’s surgery. “One change concerns the Mass scheduled for Wednesday, October 14, in St. Peter’s Square, with the meeting’s participants, including heads of Eastern Churches, Presidents of Bishops’ Conferences, married couples, and experts,” the Vatican News said.
